subject: Dedicated capacity pledge request — Elara Systems
messages:
From: Sarah Moore <sarah.moore@elara.com>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-03-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity ask — late-stage close (Elara)

Hi Priya,

Weve reached the internal procurement sign-off for our dedicated deployment and expect an exec-level close in ~2 weeks. We still need Redwood to provide an advance 'roster pledge' — basically a short-term allocation guarantee for the first 12 weeks so we can commit timelines to our customers.

Rough sizing from our side is attached (Elara_capacity_request.pdf). Key points:
- Target steady-state: 48 A100-equivalent GPUs (8 nodes x 6 GPUs) for model serving at 1280 token windows.
- Burst profile: up to +20% for a 72-hour onboarding window.
- Optional: 16 GPUs for a staging cluster for validation.

Can Redwood provide a pledge path (soft-hold or conditional allocation) and a rough ETA for node readiness? Also any required paperwork we should start now?

Thanks —
Sarah Moore
Head of AI Ops, Elara Systems
(sarah.moore@elara.com)
(attachment: Elara_capacity_request.pdf)

From: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Moore <sarah.moore@elara.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-03-13T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity ask — late-stage close (Elara)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the detail and the attachment. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Jordan (capacity planning) to confirm what we can safely pledge without impacting existing commitments.

Preliminary notes from me:
- We can offer a conditional 12-week pledge for the 48-GPU steady-state with a 72-hour burst allowance, subject to final node-type confirmation (A100 vs A10G equivalencies) and a signed MOU.
- For the staging cluster, we can often spin a small 16-GPU staging pool from general purpose nodes, but that depends on region and current fleet health.

Ben/Jordan — can you run a quick availability tally for US-west region and propose a minimal pledge wording (soft-hold + capacity float %) we can share with Elara? Also indicate any lead-time for node prep and whether we need to reserve specific chassis/slots.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
(priya.natarajan@redwood.ai)

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Moore <sarah.moore@elara.com>
Date: 2029-03-13T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity ask — late-stage close (Elara)

Priya / Jordan / Sarah — quick availability check from ops:

Summary (US-west cluster pool):
- Total free A100-eq GPUs today: 96 (across 16 nodes of 6 GPUs each).
- Committed but not active: 24 GPUs reserved for firm contracts with Q2 start dates.
- Maintenance windows: 2 nodes flagged for firmware updates next week (Mar 19-20).

Proposed pledge plan:
- Soft-pledge 48 GPUs (8 nodes) for 12 weeks with a 20% burst allowance (acknowledged in writing). Soft-pledge means we mark nodes as prioritized for Elara but allow recall with 72-hour notice in case of higher-priority emergencies.
- Hold staging cluster as 16 GPUs on general-purpose nodes; these can be warmed within 48 hours but will be subject to final validation schedule.
- To lock beyond soft-pledge we require a 60% commit (deal deposit or contractual MOU).

Attachments: DC_capacity_snapshot_Mar2029.pdf (current pool & pending maintenance)

Next steps for legal/commercial: Priya — if we share the soft-pledge wording below, Sarah, can Elara sign an MOU that states the pledge is conditional pending 60% commit? If yes, Ill coordinate the internal ticket to flag nodes and hold the staging slice.

Suggested soft-pledge wording (one-liner for MOU):
"Redwood Inference will prioritize allocation of up to 48 GPUs in the US-west dedicated pool for Elara Systems for a period of up to twelve (12) weeks. This allocation is a soft-pledge and may be recalled with 72 hours' notice in case of higher-priority capacity events. A firm hold requires a contractual commitment of at least 60% of estimated spend."

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
(attachment: DC_capacity_snapshot_Mar2029.pdf)

From: dcops@colossusinfra.io <dcops@colossusinfra.io>
To: priya.natarajan@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2029-03-15T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity ask — late-stage close (Elara)

Hi team — this is Colossus DataCenterOps. We reviewed the request and can provision a provisional allocation as described. Notes:

- We can earmark 8 nodes (48 GPUs) in rack cluster-usw-4 for a soft-pledge window starting 2029-03-18. Nodes will be tainted with a scheduling priority tag 'pledge:ELR-1175'.
- Staging slice (16 GPUs) can be instantiated as a separate tenant slice on general-purpose nodes in 36-48 hours after request.
- Firmware maintenance on two nodes will not affect the earmarked racks.

Required next actions from Redwood:
1) Send the MOU copy with the suggested one-liner to dcops@colossusinfra.io for our change control record.
2) Confirm the region and preferred node type (A100-40GB preferred; A10G fallback ok).

We will not finalize the internal booking until we see the MOU signed or a written request from Redwood sales ops. Once received, we can mark the nodes and set the recall policy in the scheduler.

Regards,
Alexei Kuznetsov
Capacity Lead, Colossus Infra (DataCenterOps)
(dcops@colossusinfra.io)
(attachment: Elara_MAO_estimate_v2.xlsx)
